exposure: Number of digital vaginal examinations during labor
cohort: 287 neonates admitted to the neonatal intensive care unit at Hawassa University Comprehensive Specialized Hospital, Sidama Regional State, Ethiopia.
finding: Neonatal sepsis was prevalent in 56% of the neonates admitted to the NICU, and cesarean delivery, resuscitation at birth, and NG tube insertion were significantly associated with neonatal sepsis.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was found to be significantly associated with neonatal sepsis.
gest_age: Mean gestational age was 3.2 days (likely referring to mean age of neonates at admission, not gestational age at birth), with 39% born preterm (<37 weeks).
